messages:
Alex: Scheduling a dry-run perf for monterey13b tonight 21:30 PST. Goal: baseline latency + batch/throughput curves up to bs=64 with 8k context. Need weights S3 uri, tokenizer quirks, and any config gotchas. @Maria @Jon can you confirm? :rocket:

Maria: weights are at s3://redwood-models/monterey13b/v1.2/monterey13b-fp16.pt
Note: there is also an int8 QAT shard at s3://redwood-models/monterey13b/int8/ (different vocab mapping). For the baseline use fp16 v1.2. Also tokenizer meta has pad_token_id = -1 in HF — set pad_token_id to eos_token_id to avoid dynamic-padding slowdowns.

Alex: got it. can you paste the exact env vars / commands we should run for tokenizer prep? i want to script it into the perf job.

Maria: sure — use:
```
export MODEL_URI=\"s3://redwood-models/monterey13b/v1.2/\"
python -m redwood.tools.tokenizer_fix --model $MODEL_URI --set-pad \"<|pad|>\" --pad-id $(python -c \"from transformers import AutoTokenizer; print(AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('monterey13b').eos_token_id)\")
```
Also set `truncate_strategy='right'` in the serving config or you'll get odd kv cache misses on short prompts.

Jon: config notes — set `max_seq_length=8192`, `kv_cache_shards=1` (default), `layernorm_eps=1e-5`. If you enable `fused_kv_cache=True` on A100s you'll need runtime >= r2.7 otherwise it falls back and you see ~3-5ms penalty per token. Also ensure `attention_dropout=0.0` for perf runs.

Alex: perf command i'm planning to run:
```
bench-run --model s3://redwood-models/monterey13b/v1.2/ \
  --context 8192 --batch-sizes 1,2,4,8,16,32,64 --seq-lens 128,512,2048 --gpus 4 --warmup 300 --steps 1200 \
  --save-metrics /tmp/monterey13b-dryrun.json
```
Anyone seen memory OOMs with long seqs on 80GB cards? :eyes:

Sophie: with the fp16 checkpoint, 4x A100-80GB was fine up to seq=2048 and bs=8. At 8192 we had to drop to bs=1 and disable certain attention recompute because of transient CPU memcpy spikes. Watch for `cudaMemcpy` stalls in the logs — they correlate with long tail latency.

Rachel: please pin the catalog entry to version `v1.2` in the PR and add a canary route (`monterey13b-canary`) so product teams can validate. Also add a perf dashboard target and link an eval set.

bench-bot: perf-job queued (id=jb-1978-21). Running on pool:dedicated-a100. ETA ~8m. Logs: https://redwood-internal/bench/jb-1978

Alex: thanks — i'll start the run at 21:30 PST, capture p50/p95/p99 latency, throughput and tokens/sec curves, and post a short summary with the dashboard link. If any config updates are needed, reply here. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: note — small infra maintenance window at 23:30 PST for kernel patching. Jobs active during the window may be preempted. Recommend running earlier or enabling checkpointing.

Alex: moving job earlier to 21:30 PST to avoid the window. will post results after the run.
